About Us

Your Neighborhood
Liquor Store

Country Liquors has been serving the Hayward community right here at 201 Jackson Street — your one-stop shop for cold beer, great wine, top-shelf spirits, snacks, and everyday essentials.

We pride ourselves on friendly service, a well-organized store, and a selection that truly has something for everyone. Can't find what you're looking for? Just ask — we'll do our best to bring it in.

Beyond liquor, we offer lottery tickets, scratchers, MoneyGram, money orders, phone cards, and domestic & craft beer kegs.
